title: Original observation: determinants, eigenlines and relative late heat
purpose: Determine which growing inverse-power classes survive the unchanged conductor observation, including their metric determinants and measured heat.
completed: Explicit finite observation constants; a common determinant coefficient for fixed-coefficient inverse-power subquotients; relative measured-heat control and its eventual positive four-cutoff trace return; original-metric observation bounds for conductor-detected eigenlines.
receiving_maps: The attained metric is (F(W* H_N W)^(-1)F*)^(-1); IFH4–7 retains its reference metric. IFH16–17 calculates the observation action through the full block resolvent and memory kernel.
limitations: This does not evaluate the full canonical-kernel strip-angle coefficient or individual complex projected-current signs and does not conclude RH.
human_sources: Original DLMF equation TeX and named authors are retained with versions and reading scope; inherited Forrester and Johansson attribution stays with the prior proofs.
validation: 85 exact auxiliary checks and 6 numerical heat checks are owner evidence, not a formal certificate of all analytic arguments.
